svg.title: Tako Ramen — Eight arms, one great bowl
svg.desc: A coral-red octopus in a chef's hat cooks ramen in a turquoise night-market booth. Eight curling arms stir a pot, wield a ladle and chopsticks, and serve bowls under a golden striped awning and paper lantern. A warm cream border frames the detailed navy, teal, and vermilion illustration.
